_comment: Bloomberg securities for the scrap tracker. VERIFY the exact security strings in your Terminal (type the description, or LME <GO>) — the tickers below are common forms but confirm before trusting. LME prices are USD/tonne, which matches the tracker's convention.

lme_alloy._desc: LME Aluminium Alloy 3-Month rolling forward. CONFIRM: also seen as NASAAC (North American Special Aluminium Alloy) — for US cast scrap prefer the NASAAC contract; set its security here.

lme_aluminum._desc: LME Primary Aluminium 3-Month rolling forward (refresh of the primary anchor).

_field_note: PX_LAST maps to the LME official/close on most setups; PX_SETTLE for official settlement. Override per-run with --field.
